title: The classes of failure to which each rule belongs

verses.t: When it comes to the offenses for a lustful nun consenting to a lustful man making physical contact with her, to how many of the four kinds of failure do they belong? They belong to two kinds of failure: they may be failure in morality; they may be failure in conduct. …
When it comes to the offenses for asking for curd and then eating it, to how many of the four kinds of failure do they belong? They belong to one kind of failure: failure in conduct.
The classes of failure to which each rule belongs, the third, are finished.
